v_sound.CEBUANO_TO_ENGLISH: Tip: The letter V makes a sound by touching your top teeth to your lower lip. Example: 'very' sounds like 'bery' but with teeth touching lip.
v_sound.FULL_ENGLISH: Tip: For the V sound, touch your upper teeth to your lower lip and push air out.
v_sound.CEBUANO_ENGLISH_MIXED: Tip (V): I-touch ang imong ngipon sa ubos nga ngabil. Example: 'very' dili 'bery'.

f_sound.CEBUANO_TO_ENGLISH: Tip: Ang F sound — i-touch ang imong ngipon sa ubos nga ngabil ug hanginon. Dili sama sa P.
f_sound.FULL_ENGLISH: Tip: For the F sound, bite your lower lip gently and push air out. It is different from P.
f_sound.CEBUANO_ENGLISH_MIXED: Tip (F): Touch upper teeth to lower lip — mas lain kay sa P.

th_sound.CEBUANO_TO_ENGLISH: Tip: Ang TH sound — ibutang ang imong dila tali sa imong mga ngipon ug hanginon. Example: 'the' dili 'da'.
th_sound.FULL_ENGLISH: Tip: For the TH sound, place your tongue between your teeth and push air out.
th_sound.CEBUANO_ENGLISH_MIXED: Tip (TH): Ibutang ang dila tali sa mga ngipon. 'The' dili 'da'.
